Can your builder change project plans after selling your flat? Here's what RERA says
description: RERA protects homebuyers from unauthorized builder changes to sanctioned plans.  Promoters need buyer consent for alterations beyond minor structural necessities.  Changes to common areas require consent from two-thirds of allottees.  Builders remain liable for structural defects for five years after possession.  Homebuyers can seek relief from the Authority for unauthorized changes.
